facts.text: Hampden-Sydney College is one of the few remaining all-male liberal arts colleges in the United States.

sources.title: Peter Orgain '22 - Hampden-Sydney College
sources.quote: Remaining all-male is vital to the core values and uniqueness of the College.

facts.text: All students must complete the college's Rhetoric Program, which includes coursework and examinations in writing and public speaking.

sources.title: The Rhetoric Program at Hampden-Sydney College
sources.quote: Consisting of course work and examinations that focus on argumentative and analytical writing and presentational speaking, the program is designed to assure that all graduates can express themselves clearly and cogently.
